title: My Sister-In-Law Forged A Dissolution And Sold My $110K Button Collection. So I Watched Her Sort
description: After my sister-in-law forged a dissolution and sold my $110K antique button collection, I discovered the original agreement sewn inside a vintage ribbon book. Now she sorts every button under a smock that reads 'Unraveled Promises,' and each button card carries her fraud docket number. #Betrayal #Karma #ButtonOfDeceit
thumb_text: SHE SORTS BUTTONS IN A SMOCK THAT SAYS UNRAVELED PROMISES
pinned_comment: If your sister-in-law forged a dissolution, sold your $110K collection, and handed you a $3,800 credit, what would you have done? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: SHE SOLD THE BUTTONS FOR $590K AND GAVE ME A $3,800 CREDIT
